concept.title: Benefits
concept.shortdesc: This section describes the benefits provided by the SMS.

li.p: This section describes the benefits provided by the SMS.
The SMS translates the collected data into actionable insights. Here are some of the benefits of using the SMS:
Non-intrusive Installation: The SMS can be attached to active motors, ensuring continuous operation.

Enhanced Plant Efficiency: The SMS monitors the health of a motor’s components and sends alerts about anomalies and degradation that can lead to faults, enabling efficient maintenance planning and reducing unexpected breakdowns.
Secure Motor Data: The SMS safely stores the motor data on the ADI OtoSense™ Server.
Better Inventory Management: The SMS assists in identifying the required spare components, thereby assisting in minimizing surplus inventory and expenditure.
Reduced Maintenance Costs: The SMS helps extend motor life by providing maintenance insights that reduce repair costs and downtime.
